name: Zhejiang Jolly Pharmaceutical Co.,LTD
summary: Zhejiang Jolly Pharmaceutical Co.,LTD engages in the research, production, and marketing of Chinese medicinal products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers Wuling capsule to treat insomnia, amnesia, heart palpitations, lack of energy, lassitude in loin and legs, and giddy tinnitus, as well as deficiency of energy and weak pulse caused by the disharmony of heart and kidney, or neurasthenia.
